# Prior-art opportunity map (public-safe, first-hand)

Source master table: `fly-connectome-cvpr2027/literature/closest-work.md` (21 first-hand
verifications, 1 UNVERIFIED NeuroGraphBench DOI NOT FOUND — do not cite until verified).

| Cluster | Covered by prior work | Remaining delta here |
|---|---|---|
| Connectome-constrained stateless GNN on static vision (arXiv:2610.10023) | fixed graph + learned gains + Kenyon readout, static shape/number/color tasks | temporal labels + spiking state, not static accuracy |
| Topology null models (arXiv:2604.04033) | early training, single MovingEdge task, degree-preserving nulls | longer horizon, multiple tasks, higher-order nulls, mechanism attribution |
| Connectome + spiking simulation (arXiv:2609.01330) | orientation maps, neural-response simulation | trainable visual readout on a CV task, controlled ablations |
| flyvis / Lappalainen Nature 2024 | connectome-constrained neural response prediction | task-level behaviour and mechanism decomposition, not neural response fitting |
| Whole-brain motor control, courtship, looming/TTC, cross-connectome robustness, time-coding | already covered by user-vetoed list | explicitly out of scope |
| High-order null models, motif/spectral controls | self-declared gap in 2604.04033 | later stage; keep as an open axis, not claimed here |

Opportunity: a **mechanism-attribution** result on temporal vision with an honest null-model
boundary. Risk: negative-result / diagnostic contributions face CVPR venue-mismatch; the
